tasks.title: Timing module: StageTimer, STAGES, format_line, parse_line
tasks.done_when: cd server && pytest tests/test_timing.py passes: format_line/parse_line round trip, STAGES lists vad, stt, mod_transcript, chat_first_sentence, chat_full, mod_reply, tts1, selftest, and a timer error is logged and not raised (F1)

tasks.title: Pipeline stage marks and one turn.latency log line
tasks.done_when: cd server && pytest tests/test_pipeline_latency.py passes: a fake-provider turn logs turn.latency_ms and all stage times (M2), failed turns log their code without latency, no transcript or reply text in the line (F5), timing overhead <= 1 ms per turn (M4); full pytest, ruff check and mypy report 0 errors (M5)

tasks.title: Phrase file: 30 phrases x EN/PL/UK
tasks.done_when: cd server && pytest tests/test_phrases.py passes: docs/research/m3-phrases.json has exactly 30 ids with en, pl and uk text each, same ids in every language, 90 phrases (M1)

tasks.title: Audio script: Piper WAV via speaches
tasks.done_when: cd server && pytest tests/test_make_phrase_audio.py passes: with speaches unreachable the script exits non-zero with a clear message before any model call (E4), and output WAV is 16 kHz mono s16le (fake HTTP client)

tasks.title: latency_run harness with pause and resume
tasks.done_when: cd server && pytest tests/test_latency_run.py passes with fake providers: plays one language WAV files in order with a set pause, captures the turn.latency line, writes side JSONL (phrase id, language, code, STT text), and --resume skips done ids (E2)

tasks.title: latency_report: p50/p95 per stage and language
tasks.done_when: cd server && pytest tests/test_latency_report.py passes on a fixed sample log and JSONL: exact p50 and p95 per stage and language (M3), budget row per stage with footnote, first turn per run left out of p50 (F3), failures counted by code and excluded (E1), missing stages counted (E3), WER per language (E5), chat_full minus chat_first_sentence shown, synthetic-input note present (F4), unmeasured rows show 'not measured'

tasks.title: Guide: make audio, run, report, LiteLLM checklist
tasks.done_when: grep -c 'make_phrase_audio\|latency_run\|latency_report' docs/guides/latency-run.md returns 3 or more, and the file has a LiteLLM checklist section for issue #20 (model ids, STT/TTS fallback) and states the M6 target p50 <= 5 s per language
